We were very happy with the whole procedure.  They visited us here as they were installing a number of systems in the area. They were easy to deal with and the installation team were punctual and did a satisfactory job explaining and showing us how it all worked. The grid connection was also all organised by them. Overall very happy!!

Very keen sales practice: quoted on Christmas Day. When I responded in the New Year, the price had gone up by $400. I queried why, and they said the rebate had changed in 2022 but that they would be happy to revert to the original price. (Fact check: the rebate changed in June 2021). They said they would conduct the rebate process and I wouldn't have to do a thing.I started to sign a contract, but noticed the price had reverted to the more expensive one, so I rang and had that fixed. Then they asked me for photos of my driver's licence, medicare card and rates notice, which I sent by text, asking that they apply appropriate confidentiality protocols.Then Solar Vic sent me an email telling me to apply for the rebate, and asking for the same documents! That worried me, so I rang the Oz Solar office and couldn't get through. When I called them directly they became defensive and quite patronising. While we were on the phone the office was also trying to get through, several times. He wanted me to talk to a higher up in the company, who left a message from "Bliss Financial Services".I sent a text saying the deal was off, then took a call from them as a courtesy. They were quite inarticulate and wanted to bring their manager into the call to "explain it to them". I recognised this as an attempt to pressure me. This was followed by more calls (which I did not respond to) and attempts to contact me again by email. The price was further dropped. All the written communication was in bad English by the way: "Oz Solar". Now I am worried that they have so much of my personal information. Very unprofessional and many red flags.

Thank you Sam and Vicky for a very professional process with our Solar installation. We were kept informed every step of the way. Installers were great.. and all went smoothly. Highly recommend Oz Solar. Very happy.
